speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic. I am Dr. Agent; I see you are experiencing fever and abdominal tenderness following childbirth. To begin, how many weeks postpartum are you, and has your baby's umbilical cord fallen off yet?

speaker: Patient
text: 24-year-old woman. The patient is in the postpartum period after delivering an 11 pound boy vaginally at 40 weeks gestation. She experienced a prolonged course during labor. She reports increased frequency of urination and uterine tenderness. She also mentions a decrease in bowel sounds.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Postpartum Endometritis secondary to a postpartum Urinary Tract Infection.

I am concerned about the combination of fever, uterine tenderness, and urinary frequency following a prolonged labor. Before we finalize this, could you clarify if you are experiencing any pain when urinating or if you have noticed any changes in the color or smell of your vaginal discharge?
